[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 11 tips for storing and preserving vintage postcards, including handling with care, storing in a cool, dry place, using acid-free materials, organizing and categorizing, storing upright, avoiding PVC materials, using archival-quality sleeves, avoiding over-stuffing, considering climate control, monitoring and maintaining, and making a backup.
